title_en: Li Ronghui, Deng Guojin, and Wang Ping — case of causing casualties by dangerous methods of manufacturing and selling toxic alcohol
keywords_en: criminal; endangering public security by dangerous means; second instance; Supreme People's Court; Sichuan Province; natural person; Criminal Law; conviction for causing casualties by substituting industrial alcohol for liquor; determination of principal and accessory offenders; application of death penalty; affirmation of original judgment; adulterating industrial alcohol with water to pass off as liquor; methanol poisoning; causing death
full_text_en:
Li Ronghui, Deng Guojin, Wang Ping — Causing Death and Injury by Dangerous Method of Manufacturing and Selling Toxic Alcohol

Defendant: Li Ronghui, male, 29 years old, former manager of the Zijing Township Comprehensive Store in Qijiang County, Sichuan Province.

Defendant: Deng Guojin, male, 57 years old, retired worker of the Yongxin District Grain Station in Qijiang County, Sichuan Province, and father-in-law of Li Ronghui.

Defendant: Wang Ping, male, 32 years old, worker of the Qijiang County Tannery, Sichuan Province, and brother-in-law of Li Ronghui.

In December 1984 and February 1985, Defendant Li Ronghui twice conspired with Defendant Deng Guojin and others to purchase 5.88 tons of medical alcohol through illegal channels, illegally mix it with water, and sell it as "white liquor" for profit. In early April 1985, Li Ronghui again twice instructed Deng Guojin to go to Chongqing to find sources of alcohol. After arriving in Chongqing, Deng discovered that the Chongqing Agricultural and Trade Joint Center was selling industrial alcohol. He immediately returned to Qijiang County and informed Li Ronghui. On April 16, Li Ronghui went to the Joint Center to verify the information, then returned to Qijiang County and instructed Deng to pretend to be purchasing on behalf of the Qijiang Plastic Factory for the purpose of making film varnish, and to go to Chongqing to ask Wang Ping for help in arranging the purchase. On April 21, Deng went to Chongqing and told Wang of Li's intention. The next day, Deng and Wang went to the Chongqing Agricultural and Trade Joint Center to purchase, but the stock was sold out. They then contacted the Chongqing Chuandong Trading Company and agreed on a purchase price of 1,350 yuan per ton for industrial alcohol. On April 23, Deng Guojin returned to Qijiang County and told Li Guorong, who indicated they could proceed with the purchase. On April 25, Deng Guojin, together with Wang Ping, purchased 2.24 tons of industrial alcohol from the Chongqing Chuandong Trading Company in the name of the Qijiang Plastic Factory, along with one bottle of quxiang flavoring and two liang of saccharin. The following evening, Li Ronghui transported this batch of industrial alcohol to Deng Guojin's place, where Li and Deng mixed the flavoring and saccharin into the alcohol. Subsequently, Li Ronghui sold this industrial alcohol as "high-proof miscellaneous grain liquor" wholesale to seven individual retailers in Xinjian, Zijing, and Yongxin Townships, instructing them to add water before selling. After the public purchased and consumed the liquor, 78 people suffered methanol poisoning, of whom 10 died and 4 lost their eyesight.

On August 13, 1985, the Chongqing Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province rendered a judgment finding that Defendants Li Ronghui, Deng Guojin, and Wang Ping, knowing that consuming "white liquor" made by diluting industrial alcohol was harmful to human health, and for the purpose of seeking exorbitant profits with disregard for the safety of human life, used deceptive means to purchase industrial alcohol and sold it as "high-proof miscellaneous grain liquor," causing extremely serious consequences. Their conduct constituted the crime of causing death and injury by the dangerous method of manufacturing and selling toxic alcohol. Li Ronghui and Deng Guojin were the principal offenders in this case, with especially serious crimes and especially vile circumstances. Defendant Wang Ping played a supporting role in the joint crime and was an accessory. In accordance with Article 106, Paragraph 1, Article 53, Paragraph 1, and Article 24 of the Criminal Law, the court sentenced Li Ronghui to death and deprivation of political rights for life; sentenced Deng Guojin to death with a two-year suspension of execution and deprivation of political rights for life; and sentenced Wang Ping to fixed-term imprisonment of five years. After the judgment was pronounced, Li Ronghui filed an appeal. On August 26, 1985, the Sichuan Higher People's Civil Court rendered a second-instance ruling rejecting Li Ronghui's appeal and affirming the first-instance judgment.

The Sichuan Higher People's Court has approved the death penalty for Li Ronghui and the death penalty with a two-year suspension of execution for Deng Guojin, both with deprivation of political rights for life.

The Supreme People's Court found that the defendants in the above two cases, Zuo Chenghong, Li Yongtai, Li Ronghui, and others, ignored state laws and disregarded the safety of human life. Knowing that consuming liquor made by diluting industrial alcohol with water was harmful to human health, they deliberately prepared and sold large quantities, causing the serious consequences of multiple deaths, injuries, and disabilities. Their conduct seriously endangered public safety and constituted crimes of an especially serious nature and particularly vile circumstances, warranting severe punishment according to law. The Chengdu Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province in the Zuo Chenghong and Li Yongtai case, and the Chongqing Intermediate People's Court of Sichuan Province in the Li Ronghui case, as well as the Sichuan Higher People's Court in both cases, all found the defendants guilty of the crime of causing death and injury by the dangerous method of manufacturing and selling toxic alcohol, and sentenced them under Article 106, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law. The convictions were accurate. The second-instance judgments and rulings of the Sichuan Higher People's Court, as well as its lawful approval of the death penalty for Zuo Chenghong, Li Yongtai, and Li Ronghui, and the death penalty with a suspension of execution for Deng Guojin, with deprivation of political rights for life, were all correct.

Defendant Wu Zijun, as manager of the Dayi County Second Light Industry Supply and Marketing Company, illegally established a liquor wholesale department and contracted it to Zuo Chenghong and others for operation. When he learned that Zuo and others were preparing and selling "white liquor" using edible alcohol, he stated that as long as they turned over 800 yuan each month, they could do whatever they wanted. This was extremely irresponsible and violated relevant administrative regulations. When Zuo Chenghong and others progressed to preparing and selling "white liquor" using industrial alcohol, Wu Zijun was unaware of this, and therefore did not constitute a joint offender in the crime of causing death and injury by the dangerous method of manufacturing and selling toxic alcohol. However, Wu failed to timely inspect and discover the criminal conduct of Zuo and others, neglected his duties, and thereby caused serious consequences. This constituted serious dereliction of duty. The Chengdu Intermediate People's Court and the Sichuan Higher People's Court, in accordance with Article 187 of the Criminal Law, appropriately sentenced Wu Zijun to a fixed term of imprisonment of five years for the crime of dereliction of duty, with a heavier punishment.
